package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// TeachingMode constrains assistance rules before an LLM is invoked.
type TeachingMode string

const (
	TeachingModeLesson   TeachingMode = "lesson"
	TeachingModePractice TeachingMode = "practice"
	TeachingModeHomework TeachingMode = "homework"
	TeachingModeProject  TeachingMode = "project"
	TeachingModeExam     TeachingMode = "exam"
	TeachingModeSandbox  TeachingMode = "sandbox"
)

// LearningContextType identifies the active product context without owning it.
type LearningContextType string

const (
	LearningContextGeneral      LearningContextType = "general"
	LearningContextLesson       LearningContextType = "lesson"
	LearningContextLessonTask   LearningContextType = "lesson_task"
	LearningContextPracticeTask LearningContextType = "practice_task"
	LearningContextProject      LearningContextType = "project"
)

// TeacherAction is the pedagogically controlled action selected by the teacher.
type TeacherAction string

const (
	TeacherActionRespond     TeacherAction = "respond"
	TeacherActionAskQuestion TeacherAction = "ask_question"
	TeacherActionGiveHint    TeacherAction = "give_hint"
	TeacherActionIntervene   TeacherAction = "intervene"
	TeacherActionRecommend   TeacherAction = "recommend"
	TeacherActionStaySilent  TeacherAction = "stay_silent"
)

// TeacherDecision is an explainable business decision, not model chain-of-thought.
type TeacherDecision struct {
	ID                string              `json:"id"`
	PersonalTeacherID string              `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	StudentID         string              `json:"student_id"`
	CorrelationID     string              `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID       string              `json:"causation_id,omitempty"`
	LearningActionID  string              `json:"learning_action_id,omitempty"`
	TeachingMode      TeachingMode        `json:"teaching_mode"`
	ContextType       LearningContextType `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID         string              `json:"context_id,omitempty"`
	PracticeStepID    string              `json:"practice_step_id,omitempty"`
	PedagogyMethod    string              `json:"pedagogy_method"`
	PedagogyVersion   string              `json:"pedagogy_method_version"`
	PedagogyStage     PedagogyStage       `json:"pedagogy_stage"`
	Strategy          string              `json:"strategy"`
	Action            TeacherAction       `json:"action"`
	HintLevel         *int                `json:"hint_level,omitempty"`
	ReasonCode        string              `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary     string              `json:"reason_summary"`
	PolicyVersion     string              `json:"policy_version"`
	CreatedAt         time.Time           `json:"created_at"`
}

// NewTeacherDecision validates and normalizes an explainable decision.
func NewTeacherDecision(decision TeacherDecision) (TeacherDecision, error) {
	decision.ID = strings.TrimSpace(decision.ID)
	decision.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(decision.PersonalTeacherID)
	decision.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(decision.StudentID)
	decision.CorrelationID = strings.TrimSpace(decision.CorrelationID)
	decision.CausationID = strings.TrimSpace(decision.CausationID)
	decision.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(decision.LearningActionID)
	decision.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(decision.ContextID)
	decision.PracticeStepID = strings.TrimSpace(decision.PracticeStepID)
	decision.PedagogyMethod = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(decision.PedagogyMethod))
	decision.PedagogyVersion = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(decision.PedagogyVersion))
	decision.PedagogyStage = PedagogyStage(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(string(decision.PedagogyStage))))
	decision.Strategy = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(decision.Strategy))
	decision.ReasonCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(decision.ReasonCode))
	decision.ReasonSummary = strings.TrimSpace(decision.ReasonSummary)
	decision.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(decision.PolicyVersion)
	decision.CreatedAt = decision.CreatedAt.UTC()

	if !validUUID(decision.ID) ||
		!validUUID(decision.PersonalTeacherID) ||
		!validValue(decision.StudentID, 255) ||
		!validValue(decision.CorrelationID, 128) ||
		len(decision.CausationID) > 128 ||
		!validTeachingMode(decision.TeachingMode) ||
		!validContextType(decision.ContextType) ||
		!validValue(decision.PedagogyMethod, 64) ||
		!validValue(decision.PedagogyVersion, 64) ||
		!validValue(string(decision.PedagogyStage), 64) ||
		!validValue(decision.Strategy, 64) ||
		!validTeacherAction(decision.Action) ||
		!validValue(decision.ReasonCode, 128) ||
		!validValue(decision.ReasonSummary, 1000) ||
		!validValue(decision.PolicyVersion, 64) ||
		decision.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		return TeacherDecision{}, errors.New("invalid teacher decision")
	}
	if decision.ContextType != LearningContextGeneral && !validValue(decision.ContextID, 255) {
		return TeacherDecision{}, errors.New("context_id is required for contextual teacher decisions")
	}
	if requiresLearningAction(decision.ContextType) &&
		(!validUUID(decision.LearningActionID) || decision.CorrelationID != decision.LearningActionID) {
		return TeacherDecision{}, errors.New("task teacher decisions must correlate by learning_action_id")
	}
	if !requiresLearningAction(decision.ContextType) && decision.LearningActionID != "" {
		return TeacherDecision{}, errors.New("learning_action_id is only valid for action contexts")
	}
	if decision.ContextType == LearningContextGeneral {
		decision.ContextID = ""
	}
	if decision.PracticeStepID != "" &&
		((decision.ContextType != LearningContextPracticeTask && decision.ContextType != LearningContextProject) ||
			!validValue(decision.PracticeStepID, 128)) {
		return TeacherDecision{}, errors.New("practice_step_id is only valid for a bounded practice context")
	}
	if decision.HintLevel != nil && (*decision.HintLevel < 0 || *decision.HintLevel > 7) {
		return TeacherDecision{}, errors.New("hint_level must be between 0 and 7")
	}
	if decision.Action == TeacherActionGiveHint && decision.HintLevel == nil {
		return TeacherDecision{}, errors.New("hint_level is required for hint decisions")
	}
	if decision.TeachingMode == TeachingModeExam && decision.Action == TeacherActionGiveHint {
		return TeacherDecision{}, errors.New("exam mode forbids hint decisions")
	}
	return decision, nil
}

func requiresLearningAction(contextType LearningContextType) bool {
	return contextType == LearningContextLessonTask ||
		contextType == LearningContextPracticeTask ||
		contextType == LearningContextProject
}

func validUUID(value string) bool {
	_, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil
}

func validTeachingMode(mode TeachingMode) bool {
	switch mode {
	case TeachingModeLesson, TeachingModePractice, TeachingModeHomework, TeachingModeProject, TeachingModeExam, TeachingModeSandbox:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func validContextType(contextType LearningContextType) bool {
	switch contextType {
	case LearningContextGeneral, LearningContextLesson, LearningContextLessonTask, LearningContextPracticeTask, LearningContextProject:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func validTeacherAction(action TeacherAction) bool {
	switch action {
	case TeacherActionRespond, TeacherActionAskQuestion, TeacherActionGiveHint, TeacherActionIntervene, TeacherActionRecommend, TeacherActionStaySilent:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
